verdict.rationale: Shopify documents a public, protocol-based API for agents: UCP-compliant JSON-RPC MCP endpoints for the global catalog, per-store catalogs, carts, checkout and orders. It also documents auth tiers and profile negotiation, and the UCP spec is published openly. Runtime probes independently confirmed live handshakes, keyless cart creation on a real store, and the documented profile gate. Missing for 10: no OpenAPI or llms.txt machine-readable spec on shopify.dev, order webhook subscription is not self-serve (requires a partner manager), and complete_checkout and get_order are restricted to Token-tier agents, with no hands-on verification of the checkout and order calls.
